marginalia.text: Marrow-Saint Ilyra named the salt litany. The fountain answered with three drops above the surface, then stopped.
Venn Hook offered 8 scrip for the dagger you have not made yet. He does not ask whether you have salt-iron. He assumes.
Bell-Magistrate Orro recorded your name in the visitor ledger. He misspelled it. The misspelling is the canonical entry.
The fountain leaked upward. Three bystanders looked. One was Bell Court; one was Drowned Church; one was you. The Bell Court witness will file a report by night.
Bell-Marked Charm attuned: salt-immersion ritual completed. Slot 0 bound. The charm spoke twice on the second submersion. You did not understand it.
The Listening Child answered a question. You had not yet asked it. The Bell Court scribe nearby did not write it down because no question was on record.
The Butcher Who Repeats did not repeat in your presence today. He said one thing once. He looked surprised by the silence after.
Salt-scrip moved from 0.85 to 0.72 between morning and midday. No one named the cause aloud. The Tide League's chalkboard does not show the morning value.
The Bell Court bell struck once outside its recorded hour. The scribes pretended not to hear. The bell does not.
Two singers held the third line of the salt-vigil round when the fourth dropped out. The round continued. No one looked at the singer who dropped.
Salt-dust fell south of the market today instead of north. The fishermen noticed; the bookkeepers did not. The fishermen are usually right about this.
Authority would have advanced today, except you refused the offered name. Authority does not advance on refusal; the credit is held against the next canon-event you do not refuse.
Something in the room — the room itself — adjusts to the weight you have begun to carry. The candles do not flicker. The candles know.
The cuff of the left sleeve has gone the colour the rust would be if rust were warm. The cuff is not rust. The cuff is salt-touched, set into the weave like a stain that has decided.
A line is drawn on a piece of paper and the paper is not the same paper. The line is also not a line. This is acceptable.

marginalia.trigger_condition: item_bell_marked_charm warms for the first time (proximity to Bell Court ledger entry)
marginalia.text: The charm in the pocket — small, brass, salt-stamped — is warm against the thigh. Something has been entered into a ledger somewhere very close.
The pebble is back in the pocket. The drop did not take. The pebble is not a thing that is lost.
The haze on the market today carries grit that settles on the tongue. The grit tastes like the spoken syllables of someone who has not spoken yet.
The standing-water that is not standing has caught the late silver light. The fountain is not reflecting. The fountain is being addressed.

marginalia.trigger_condition: fac_drowned_church performs salt_vigil_evening with player observing
marginalia.text: The salt-vigil is exactly what was described. Exactness is the unsettling part.
Three clerks at three desks reading three ledgers aloud at three different rates. The reading does not synchronize. It does not need to.

marginalia.trigger_condition: Marrow-Saint Ilyra refuses to acknowledge player (faith_drowned_church <= -3)
marginalia.text: She looked through, not at. The looking-through was deliberate. It is not the same as being unseen.

marginalia.trigger_condition: Bell-Magistrate Orro sets inkwell aside (off-record marker)
marginalia.text: He set the inkwell down. The conversation is off the record now. The conversation was never going to be on it.
The child speaks the way one repeats something already said. The thing already said has not yet been said.

marginalia.trigger_condition: Butcher Who Repeats discloses the provenance of the cuts (sec_butcher_contradiction_revealed)
marginalia.text: He said it the way one says something for the third time. It was the first time it had been said aloud to anyone.
